nodes.label: Masked Pain / Facade of Normalcy
nodes.description: The phrase 'I'M FINE' is painted directly on the subject's forehead, representing the social mask worn by PTSD sufferers who deny or hide their internal suffering to appear functional.

nodes.label: Internal Emotional Chaos
nodes.description: Explosively vibrant, swirling multi-color paint strokes covering the entire canvas depict the overwhelming, chaotic nature of PTSD — the relentless emotional storm beneath the surface.

nodes.label: Silent Suffering
nodes.description: The subject's eyes are closed with dark tears streaming down the cheeks, symbolising hidden grief, hypervigilance, and the exhaustion of suppressing traumatic memory.

nodes.label: Tension and Overwhelm
nodes.description: Both hands press against the temples in a classic stress / head-clutching posture, conveying the pressure of intrusive thoughts, flashbacks, and hyperarousal characteristic of PTSD.

nodes.label: Contradiction Between Appearance and Reality
nodes.description: The juxtaposition of vivid, saturated colours (which read as vibrant / alive) against closed eyes and streaming tears encapsulates the PTSD paradox: looking 'fine' while internally fractured.

nodes.label: 'I'M FINE' Forehead Text
nodes.description: Bold dark text painted on the forehead — the most prominent textual element. Directly names the social denial behaviour common in PTSD survivors.

nodes.label: Dark / Black Tears
nodes.description: Dark streaks running from closed eyes represent suppressed grief, nightmares, and emotional leakage that cannot be fully contained despite the 'I'm fine' facade.

nodes.label: Swirling, Paint-Soaked Hair
nodes.description: The subject's hair merges seamlessly with the chaotic painted background, symbolising how trauma becomes indistinguishable from the self — identity consumed by the disorder.

nodes.label: Fingers Pressing Temples
nodes.description: A universal gesture of mental strain. In the PTSD context it represents intrusive memories, flashbacks, and the effort required to stay grounded in the present.

nodes.label: High-Saturation Warm Color Palette
nodes.description: Reds, oranges, yellows, purples, and blues at extreme saturation evoke hyperarousal, urgency, fire, and danger — the neurological state of someone reliving trauma.

nodes.label: PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder)
nodes.description: A trauma- and stressor-related disorder characterised by intrusive memories, avoidance, negative alterations in cognition/mood, and hyperarousal following exposure to a traumatic event.

nodes.label: Expressive Digital Oil-Painting Style
nodes.description: The image mimics thick impasto oil-painting with digital swirling brushwork, lending emotional intensity and the sense of being overwhelmed — reinforcing the psychological subject matter.

nodes.label: Dark Shadow Hands
nodes.description: Large dark claw-like hands reaching from shadows toward the person's face and head, symbolising the intrusive, oppressive nature of intrusive thoughts and anxiety that accompany insomnia

nodes.label: Clock Above Bed
nodes.description: An analog clock positioned above the headboard showing late-night/early-morning time, representing time-awareness and the ticking dread of sleeplessness

nodes.label: Bed / Bedroom Setting
nodes.description: A bed with headboard framing the scene, the expected place of rest turned into a site of distress

nodes.label: Chaotic Scribble Background

nodes.label: Bipolar Disorder
nodes.description: A mental health condition characterized by extreme mood swings between depressive and manic episodes

nodes.label: Duality / Split Composition
nodes.description: The image is split vertically into two halves representing opposing emotional states — the left side depicting depression and the right side depicting mania

nodes.label: Depressive Episode Visual (Left Half)
nodes.description: Left half features a dark black background, a crying figure with dark hair, tears, cobwebs, chains, spirals, a broken heart, frowning face, and red roses — symbols of sadness, entrapment, and despair

nodes.label: Manic Episode Visual (Right Half)
nodes.description: Right half features a vivid blue background with rainbows, hearts, smiley faces, peace symbols, colorful swirling patterns, stars, and a pink bow — symbols of euphoria, energy, and heightened emotion

nodes.label: Split-Face Figure
nodes.description: A central figure whose face is divided in half — the left side pale and tearful with gothic makeup, the right side adorned with a star and colorful hair — representing a person living with both poles of bipolar disorder

nodes.label: Dark Symbols (Depression Side)
nodes.description: Symbols on the dark side include cobwebs, chains, a broken heart, frowning emoji face, tears, spirals, and a red arrow downward — connoting low mood, entrapment, and hopelessness

nodes.label: Bright Symbols (Mania Side)
nodes.description: Symbols on the bright side include rainbow arcs, peace signs, hearts, smiley faces, a sun, stars, and circular patterns — connoting euphoria, hyperactivity, and positive affect

nodes.label: Hand-Drawn Illustration Style
nodes.description: The image is a hand-drawn illustration using what appears to be markers or colored pencils, characteristic of expressive mental health awareness artwork

nodes.label: Mental Health Awareness Site Context
nodes.description: This image is used as a micro-reflection thumbnail on a mental health awareness website (soulful-reflections), representing the bipolar disorder topic

nodes.label: Mood Contrast Metaphor
nodes.description: The stark black-and-white vs. vivid-color contrast serves as a visual metaphor for the dramatic shift in mood, energy, and perception experienced in bipolar disorder episodes

nodes.label: Woman Subject
nodes.description: A young dark-haired woman shown from behind, looking into a mirror with her hand raised to her chin in a contemplative or self-examining gesture.

nodes.label: Broken Mirror
nodes.description: A cracked and shattered ornate wooden-framed mirror reflecting a distorted, fragmented image of the woman's face. The cracks radiate from an impact point at the top, symbolizing distorted self-perception.

nodes.label: Distorted Reflection
nodes.description: The fragmented reflection of the woman's face in the broken mirror, visually representing how individuals with body dysmorphic disorder perceive their appearance as distorted or flawed.

nodes.label: Visual Style
nodes.description: Dark, muted tones with a painterly or illustration aesthetic. High contrast between the dark background and the pale skin and white collar of the subject. Mood is somber and introspective.

nodes.label: Body Dysmorphic Disorder (BDD)
nodes.description: A mental health condition characterized by obsessive focus on perceived flaws in physical appearance, often leading to significant distress and impaired functioning. The person's self-image is distorted relative to reality.

nodes.label: Mirror Symbolism
nodes.description: The broken mirror is a central visual metaphor: mirrors are associated with self-examination and self-image; a shattered mirror represents broken or distorted self-perception, a hallmark of BDD.

nodes.label: Self-Examining Gaze Symbolism
nodes.description: The subject's posture — turned away from the viewer, facing the mirror, hand to chin — symbolizes compulsive self-scrutiny and the inward, obsessive self-focus characteristic of BDD.

nodes.label: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
nodes.description: Anxiety disorder characterized by intrusive obsessive thoughts and compulsive repetitive behaviors

nodes.label: Compulsive Hand Washing
nodes.description: Repetitive hand washing depicted as a core OCD compulsion; person washes hands intensely at a sink

nodes.label: Intrusive Brain / Obsessive Thought Metaphor
nodes.description: Animated brain character wearing a red cap sitting atop the person's head, holding a whip — symbolizes the intrusive, controlling nature of OCD obsessions dominating the mind

nodes.label: Distressed Person Figure

nodes.label: Sink / Running Water Symbol
nodes.description: Faucet and sink with running water representing the compulsive cleaning ritual associated with contamination OCD

nodes.label: Anxiety Disorders
